definitions.gloss: to arrange to meet, to rendezvous, to meet up at a set time and place
definitions.explanation: To agree on a time and place in advance and then meet there. The noun form 待ち合わせ is very common for referring to the meeting arrangement itself.

examples.english: To meet up in front of the station.

examples.japanese: ⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{三時|さんじ}→三時：10983_sanji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{待|ま}ち{合|あ}わせて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I'm meeting a friend at three o'clock.

examples.japanese: ⟦{待|ま}ち{合|あ}わせ→待ち合わせ：07397_machiawase⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{間違|まちが}えて→間違える：01109_machigaeru⟧しまった。
examples.english: I mistakenly went to the wrong meeting place.

notes:
{待|ま}ち{合|あ}わせる is a compound of ⟦{待|ま}つ→待つ：00469_matsu⟧ (to wait) and ⟦{合|あ}わせる→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧ (to bring together). The noun form ⟦{待|ま}ち{合|あ}わせ→待ち合わせ：07397_machiawase⟧ is used more frequently than the verb form.

Ichidan verb.
- Negative: {待|ま}ち{合|あ}わせない
- Polite: {待|ま}ち{合|あ}わせます
- Te-form: {待|ま}ち{合|あ}わせて
- Past: {待|ま}ち{合|あ}わせた
- Noun form: ⟦{待|ま}ち{合|あ}わせ→待ち合わせ：07397_machiawase⟧ (meeting arrangement)
